page_sift.ai_warn.many_researchers_are_t: Many researchers are trying AI in their work, and guidance on reporting it in a review is still forming, so check what PRISMA, your university and your journals say now. AI makes mistakes, invents facts and can lend false confidence to a decision. With these features on, the records you ask about are sent to the AI provider you choose. These features are experimental and not for a review's real screening decisions. The advice is to keep them off unless you are researching AI in evidence synthesis. They are there to suggest and to help you think, never to make the decisions that are yours as the reviewer.
page_sift.ai_confirm.not_recommended_for: Not recommended for a review's real screening.
page_sift.ai_confirm.if_you_are_new_to: If you are new to systematic reviews, learning to screen by hand matters. You may not be able to tell a good proposal from a poor one.
page_sift.ai_confirm.ai_makes_mistakes_a: AI makes mistakes and invents things, and can sound surer than it is.
page_sift.ai_confirm.the_records_you_ask: The records you ask about are sent to the AI provider you choose, so they leave your computer. Check your university's and journals' rules first.
page_sift.ai_confirm.you_may_need_to_rep: You may need to report its use when you publish.
